root.title: Deliver practically usable AGI without lowering the achievement bar

prediction.reforecast_rule: If instantiated non-replaced problems exceed the prediction, traverse all active problems, introduce shared/higher-order problems that subsume multiple branches, rewrite affected branches without duplicating completed work, then re-estimate.

rules.selection: Attempt exactly one unresolved leaf at a time unless integration requires a small atomic bundle.
rules.failed_attempt: Decompose the unresolved leaf into child problems whose integration would solve it.
rules.success: Record evidence and move to another unresolved leaf.
rules.parent_resolution: Resolve a parent only after all required children are resolved and integration is verified.
rules.truthfulness: Never mark a capability or AGI achievement as solved without empirical evidence.
rules.separation: The recursive project-management/problem-solving mechanism is not part of the AGI candidate and is excluded from AGI evaluation.

problems.title: Make AGI achievement falsifiable and attribution-correct
evidence: 23 local pytest tests passed for the integrated evaluation specification

problems.title: Build a general learning and representation substrate
Achieve robust reasoning, planning, and problem solving across domains
Achieve reliable memory and continual adaptation without catastrophic interference
Achieve multimodal perception, tool use, and environment interaction
Achieve long-horizon autonomy, self-monitoring, and recovery
Meet robustness, safety, security, and controllability requirements
Turn the system into an efficient, maintainable, practically deployable product
Integrate and independently validate the frozen AGI candidate in real use
Define the candidate boundary so cognition cannot be delegated to the project solver or an undisclosed external general model
Define sealed, post-freeze, contamination-resistant task generation and custody
Define non-compensatory pass gates for generality, performance, autonomy, safety/reliability, and practical delivery
Define statistical decision rules, uncertainty, replication, and failure handling
Define independent evaluator reproducibility and signed evidence packaging
Define a candidate-only cognitive core interface and state-transition substrate
Represent heterogeneous observations, concepts, uncertainty, and goals in a composable workspace
Learn new task rules and skills online from sparse demonstrations and feedback
Assign credit under delayed, partial, and conflicting feedback
Preserve prior capabilities while continually adapting
Compose and transfer learned skills across structurally related domains

history.note: All evaluation-definition children were integrated. This establishes a falsifiable recognition protocol, not AGI capability.

A general learning substrate cannot be verified as one atomic leaf; it was decomposed into interfaces, representation, online learning, credit assignment, continual stability, and transfer/composition.
